primary_sources.title: Task 003: Live Ingestion - Apple 2024 10-K HTML
primary_sources.synthesis: 1.43 MB SEC EDGAR 10-K filing for Apple Inc. (FY 2024). Downloaded via Task 003 SEC Edgar provider. Verified authentic source URL, SHA256 hash documented.

primary_sources.title: Task 004: Extraction Integration - Verification Results
primary_sources.synthesis: Verified EnhancedPDFExtractor can process Apple 10-K HTML. Extracted 129 chunks (256,563 characters total). Confirmed extract_from_file() API signature and output format.

primary_sources.title: Task 005: Retrieval Integration - Search Results
primary_sources.synthesis: Verified VectorStore indexing and retrieval. 50 chunks indexed with keyword-based vectorization. 3 test queries executed ('climate risk', 'environmental regulations', 'carbon emissions'). Top result scored 0.500.

primary_sources.title: Task 006: Scoring Integration - ESG Maturity Scores
primary_sources.synthesis: Verified RubricV3Scorer can score retrieval results. Apple 2024 aggregate maturity: 1.91/5.0 (Advanced), confidence: 69.1%. 3 findings scored across 7 ESG dimensions. Confirmed score_finding() API and output schema.

primary_sources.title: EnhancedPDFExtractor Implementation
primary_sources.synthesis: Production HTML extraction via regex tag stripping. extract_from_file(file_path, doc_id, chunk_size) returns list of Finding objects with text, metadata, provenance.

primary_sources.title: VectorStore In-Memory Implementation
primary_sources.synthesis: 30-line Python dict-based vector store with cosine similarity search. API: upsert(_id, vector, metadata), knn(query, k, where). Validated in Task 005.

primary_sources.title: RubricV3Scorer Implementation
primary_sources.synthesis: Deterministic keyword-based ESG scoring. score_finding(finding) returns {maturity_level, maturity_label, confidence, dimension_breakdown}. Uses rubrics/maturity_v3.json.
